_comment: Which generated sub-pages are allowed into the index. Read by src/pages/countries/[slug]/[topic].astro, src/pages/countries/[slug]/cost.astro, src/pages/services/[slug]/[country].astro and the sitemap filter in astro.config.mjs, so the robots meta and the sitemap can never disagree. Every /services/<service>/<country>/ page and every /countries/<country>/<topic>/ page is noindex,follow EXCEPT the topic pages listed here. Chosen 2026-10-23 by measuring text that appears on no other country, service, topic, hub, Arabic, Turkish or blog page (8-word shingles): every sub-page measured 13-24% unique, so only the e-invoicing pages for markets with a live or dated mandate and a real search query, plus Pakistan payroll, were kept. Each country hub is the one indexable page for 'odoo implementation <country>'. Add a page here only after its unique text is substantial.
